name: LinnDrum boogie pocket
desc: The early-80s boogie chassis: AkaiLinn kick doubling the and-of-three, clap-plus-snare stack on 2&4, offbeat open hats and 16th closed hats with accent rotation. Sidestick ghosts at full, clap rolls into phrase ends at peak.

gain.doc: kick level, other layers scale from it

clap.doc: clap+snare stack level as fraction of kick

code.full: stack(s("bd ~ [bd ~ ~ bd] ~").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(${gain}).shape(.22), s("~ [sd,cp] ~ [sd,cp]").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(${gain}*${clap}).room(.28), s("[~ oh]*4").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(${gain}*.45).lpf(6500).pan(.6), s("hh*16").bank("AkaiLinn").gain("[.44 .16 .3 .16]*4").pan(cosine.range(.42,.58).slow(9)).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)), s("rim*16").bank("AkaiLinn").degradeBy(.88).gain(.18).pan(.42)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ [bd ~ ~ bd] [~ bd ~ ~]").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(${gain}).shape(.26), s("~ [sd,cp] ~ [sd,cp]").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(${gain}*${clap}*1.1).room(.28), s("[~ oh]*4").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(${gain}*.5).lpf(7500).pan(.62), s("hh*16").bank("AkaiLinn").gain("[.5 .2 .34 .2]*4").pan(cosine.range(.38,.62).slow(7)).every(4, x=>x.ply(2)), s("rim*16").bank("AkaiLinn").degradeBy(.8).gain(.2).pan(.4), s("~ ~ ~ [~ cp cp cp]").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(${gain}*.4).mask("<0 0 0 1>")).orbit(1).play()
